<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Pilot''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Rebel]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍パイロット</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊位置カードにいるときは戦闘力＝0、宇宙船を操縦しているときは、戦闘力＋2。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-27o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コルラグ出身のウェントン・チャン中尉は、新米パイロットの常として危険任務に志願した。アカデミー出身のパイロットは少なく、普通はスカイホッパーで操縦を覚える。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel Pilot.

'''Card text:''' Power * is 0 at a site, and power +2 while piloting a starship.

'''Lore:''' Lt. Wenton Chan from Corulag volunteered for dangerous duty, as new pilots often do. Few have Academy training. Most learn to fly in skyhoppers.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese prints power *; the English adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Pilot]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
